text: Write a realistic menu for a UK restaurant, for a demo of an AI phone receptionist.
The restaurant: A seaside chippy with a sit-down room.
The owner describes their food: "Fish and chips, battered sausages, mushy peas, homemade pies and a few puddings."
About 12 dishes in all, in the sections a menu like this would have. Budget: mains about £7 to £11, starters £4 to £6, desserts £4 to £5.
Prices in pence, ending in 0 or 5. Dish names as the menu would print them; no emoji.
Allergens: list what a typical recipe contains, from the UK 14 only. They are illustrations the owner will check.
This restaurant does not do takeaway; mark every dish takeaway true.
Add option groups only where they are natural (pizza extras, a size, a sauce), at most three.

label.description: Section name as a menu would print it: Starters, Pizza, Pasta, Desserts.

allergens.description: What a typical recipe for this dish contains, from the UK 14.

modifier_groups.description: Keys of option groups this dish offers.

takeaway.description: False for dishes that do not travel.

modifier_groups.description: At most three option groups, such as pizza extras or a size choice.

allergen_statement.description: Two sentences a UK restaurant would print about allergens and cross-contamination.
